description: This file defines an Android activity called SensorTest that demonstrates the use of device sensors, specifically the accelerometer. It includes sensor event handling, gesture detection, and custom view rendering to visualize sensor data.

classes.name: SensorTest
classes.description: Main activity class handling sensor initialization, lifecycle, and event management.

classes.name: RunAve
classes.description: Helper class for maintaining a running average of sensor samples with weighted contributions.

classes.name: SensorTest.SampleView
classes.description: Custom Android view subclass用于视觉化传感器数据和交互.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up sensor manager, default accelerometer sensor, and custom view.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Registers the sensor listener with the fastest delay setting.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Unregisters the sensor listener when activity stops.
